name: branding-browser-frame-favicon-mockup-violet
title: Dark browser chrome with logo favicon cropped on a violet background
whatItIs: A dark browser window cropped at the top left on periwinkle violet, with traffic-light dots, a tab showing a violet monogram and 'Sovrix', a close button, back/forward/refresh icons and a URL 'https://sovrix.com'. The page area is blank grey.
whatItMeans: Precise and minimal; the crop makes the tiny logo the only story.
techniques: Enlarge and crop browser chrome to focus on the favicon and tab.
Use one saturated background colour matching the brand.
Keep the window content empty so nothing distracts.
Set the URL text in two greys.

vocabulary.definition: A tiny logo shown in browser tabs.
The frame of a browser window.
A close cut that enlarges a small detail.
A window with no content used as a stage.
